characters.continuity: New Super Mario Bros. series, Mario & Luigi series, and Mario franchise media
characters.summary: Dry Bowser is the skeletal, undead iteration of Bowser, capable of regenerating from his bones, breathing blue or white-hot fire, and hurling projectiles. He retains his immense strength and resilience while gaining resistance to physical blunt trauma.

techniques: Breathes small flames in New Super Mario Bros.; blue fire in later games
High jumps and a drop from the ceiling at the start of his fight
Mario & Luigi: Paper Jam: throws his head to spew blue flames, inhales foes, summons Thwomps and Koopalings

mechanisms: Skeletal resilience to blunt damage
Self-reassembly upon destruction
Immunity to conventional heat and lava
Fireproof like Dry Bones: Fire Mario's fireballs have no effect
His body falls apart when he lands after being thrown into a pit, and he reassembles for the World 8 fight

weaknesses: Vulnerability to falling into bottomless pits or structural collapse
Susceptibility to powerful magic or total disintegration
A skull switch destroys the bridge he stands on and drops him into a deep pit
A Mega Mushroom jump makes him crumble
Three shell-dash hits defeat him, as with living Bowser

limitations: Can be incapacitated if completely shattered or dropped into an abyss
characters.formDifferences: Strips away Bowser's flesh leaving a nearly indestructible skeletal frame, granting immunity to standard fire and blunt strikes while exchanging standard fireballs for more aggressive blue flame attacks and bone projectiles.

Origin in New Super Mario Bros. World 1-Castle, attacks (bones, flames, jumps; Paper Jam moves), fireproofing, falling apart and reassembling, defeat by skull switch, Mega Mushroom or shell dashes, and reversion via Bowser Jr.'s cauldron

characters.summary: Fury Bowser is a gigantic, kaiju-sized monstrous state induced by black goop. He unleashes continuous torrents of fire, summons fiery meteors from the sky, and can withstand massive kinetic impacts until confronted by Giga Cat Mario.

Fireballs that fall across the whole lake and leave circles of lava
Digs into the ground to summon large falling spikes
A shockwave of fire when he jumps at Mario
Later fights: a ring of huge fireballs and gigantic Kick Bombs

mechanisms: Colossal mass and thick impenetrable shell
Spike-covered exterior that damages attackers on contact
Gigantic size; his belly is exposed to Ground Pounds only when his shell is flipped
Claw swipes and lighthouse light deal only small damage outside that window

weaknesses: Vulnerable to the divine light of the Giga Bells and Giga Cat Mario
Flipping him exposes his belly to Ground Pounds; three Ground Pounds empty his health bar in the first battle
Lighthouse light damages him slightly
